WITH views AS (
  SELECT e.user_id, i.c1_id, i.brand_id
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_view' AND e.event_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00'
), dims AS (
  SELECT c1_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, c1_id) - 1 AS dim
  FROM (SELECT c1_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM views GROUP BY c1_id) c
  ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 64
), counts AS (
  SELECT v.user_id, d.dim, COUNT(*) AS n FROM views v JOIN dims d ON d.c1_id = v.c1_id GROUP BY v.user_id, d.dim
), totals AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(n) AS total FROM counts GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(n) >= 20
), taste AS (
  SELECT c.user_id AS id,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 0 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d0,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 1 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d1,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 2 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d2,
         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 3 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d3,

         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 14 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d14,

         CAST(SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.dim = 63 THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / t.total) AS REAL) AS d63
  FROM counts c JOIN totals t ON t.user_id = c.user_id
  GROUP BY c.user_id, t.total
), pokemon_buys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id, CASE WHEN e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS later
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'buy_comp' AND i.brand_id = 17470 AND e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00'
), seed AS (
  SELECT t.id FROM taste t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM pokemon_buys WHERE later = 0) b ON b.user_id = t.id
), candidates AS (
  SELECT t.* FROM taste t LEFT JOIN seed s ON s.id = t.id WHERE s.id IS NULL

), pokemon_viewers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS id FROM views WHERE brand_id = 17470
), later_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS id FROM pokemon_buys WHERE later = 1
), audiences AS (
  SELECT 'lookalikes' AS audience, l.id FROM lookalikes l
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pokemon viewers', c.id FROM candidates c JOIN pokemon_viewers v ON v.id = c.id
  UNION ALL SELECT 'all active shoppers', c.id FROM candidates c
)
SELECT a.audience, COUNT(*) AS shoppers, COUNT(b.id) AS buyers_sep_oct,
       CAST(COUNT(b.id) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS purchase_rate
FROM audiences a LEFT JOIN later_buyers b ON b.id = a.id
GROUP BY a.audience
ORDER BY purchase_rate DESC
